name: Truck Me
tagline: Truck repairs, maintenance and funding — found in minutes, with 24/7 support
role: Mobile development for a US fleet-services startup

scenes.title: Built for owner-operators
scenes.body: Find service, get help and manage repair spend — all from one app.

scenes.title: A live map of truck services
scenes.body: Repair, tires, oil and towing nearby, filtered by truck brand and routed in one tap.

scenes.title: Real-time support chat
scenes.body: Socket-powered messaging with recorded voice notes for drivers on the road.

scenes.title: Discounts and a credit line
scenes.body: Maintenance discounts and funding that keep a fleet's cash flow predictable.
